jobs.prompt: A complete EMPTY Chinese high-school classroom interior background for a pixel-art desktop idle game, 384x256 pixels. Floor diamond corners near (10,157),(192,66),(374,157),(192,248); two rear walls meet around (192,7) above back floor corner (192,66). The LEFT rear wall runs down-left and has two simple pale-blue classroom windows. The RIGHT rear wall runs down-right and carries a large dark green chalkboard facing the students toward the lower-left. The future students face north-east/up-right toward this right wall, exactly like the separate desk reference. Clock beside the chalkboard, simple door near far right wall end, small potted plant near left wall end, no bulky cabinets or floor clutter. Keep floor roughly x35..350,y104..230 empty so four units can be placed in a 2x2 diamond arrangement with grounded centers (192,123),(104,167),(280,167),(192,211). Do not draw markers or slots. Muted pale mint walls, muted grey-green floor tiles, warm tan chalkboard trim, light blue windows, simple soft daytime lighting, crisp one-native-pixel edges, compact pixel clusters, restrained detail, no smooth gradients, no blur, no text labels, no UI, no perspective convergence, no additional rooms. Draw full floor and both walls inside the canvas with 4px outer margin; opaque very pale mint outside the cutaway. This is usable empty game background art, not an illustration or a sheet.
